description: Query the dLocal FX rate for a destination country/currency pair. Used to preview converted amounts before a payout or USD-funded charge.

amount.description: Optional source amount to convert; the response will include the destination value

from_currency.description: Source currency ISO-4217 (typically USD or EUR)

to_currency.description: Destination local currency ISO-4217 (BRL, MXN, ARS, etc)

name: get_exchange_rate
